description: Kept the dinner on her own slate, and sent the phrase out with the men.
name: Agnes Tipping

description: Paid the twelve pence, reported the page, named Long Meg, and brought no receipt.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Asked after the sums, feared the farthing more than the day, and closed the plot.
name: John Heminges

description: Took the twelve pence and had yesterday's play set against the thirtieth.
name: Philip Henslowe

description: Proposed playing twice, and kept the meat.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked a wage for the invented day, and offered sixpence for a thirty-second of May.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said who knows what matters, and left the king's leaf at home.
name: William Shakespeare
